title: Intermolecular interaction and residual joining
statement: An intermolecular interaction is a registered response channel between already complete molecular carriers that retains each constituent molecular identity and supports collective recurrence.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered intermolecular carrier, support, identity, recurrence, boundary, strength, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite interaction support joining two or more already complete molecular carriers while retaining each molecular identity and the boundary between inter- and intramolecular support.

choices.name: one-molecule-internal-edge
choices.reason: An internal edge is intramolecular support.

choices.name: distinct-molecular-carriers
choices.reason: The interaction endpoints are separate molecular wholes.

choices.name: proximity-without-channel
choices.reason: Proximity alone supplies no interaction trace.

choices.name: between-whole-interaction-support
choices.reason: A registered channel joins the molecular carriers.

choices.name: constituents-merged-erased
choices.reason: Erasing each molecule changes the class to a new bonded carrier.

choices.name: transient-coincidence
choices.reason: A coincidence without response cannot organize an assembly.

choices.name: collective-recurrence
choices.reason: The joined carriers participate in a repeatable joint response.

choices.name: inter-intra-conflation
choices.reason: Conflation makes every covalent edge intermolecular.

choices.name: explicit-molecular-boundary
choices.reason: Endpoint ownership distinguishes inter- from intramolecular support.

choices.name: universal-weaker-law
choices.reason: Not every context forces one strength ordering.

choices.name: source-bounded-interaction-record
choices.reason: Strength and range remain empirical records, not derivation premises.

choices.name: force-name-only
choices.reason: A force name cannot reconstruct endpoints and response.

choices.name: carrier-channel-recurrence-trace
choices.reason: Carriers, channel and conditions remain held.

choices.name: free-force-family
choices.reason: An imported family can select desired interactions.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Between-whole support determines the structural class.

induction_base: Two complete molecular carriers joined by one retained between-whole response channel supply the first intermolecular assembly.
induction_step: Appending one molecular carrier and generated channel preserves every component identity and extends collective recurrence only inside the declared boundary.
exclusions: no chemical dictionary, coordinate archive, fitted force field, measured geometry or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no application or opaque prediction result
no claim that topology alone predicts every measured coordinate or energy
external content remains inaccessible until after the consequence is sealed
Every finite interaction support joining two or more already complete molecular carriers while retaining each molecular identity and the boundary between inter- and intramolecular support.
operational_witnesses: one channel joins two distinct molecular wholes
both molecular identifiers remain in the assembly
no universal strength ranking is asserted
falsification_condition: The claim fails if the official record lacks interaction between distinct molecules or preserved molecular endpoints, or if a changed row is accepted.
